def dinic(net, source, sink):
    to = net.to; frm = net.frm; cap = net.cap; adj = net.adj
    n = net.n
    total = 0
    while True:
        level = [-1]*n
        level[source] = 0
        queue = [source]
        while queue:
            nxt = []
            for u in queue:
                mark = level[u] + 1
                for arc in adj[u]:
                    if cap[arc] > 0:
                        v = to[arc]
                        if level[v] < 0:
                            level[v] = mark
                            nxt.append(v)
            queue = nxt
        if level[sink] < 0:
            return total
        it = [0]*n
        path = []
        u = source
        while True:
            if u == sink:
                push = min(cap[a] for a in path)
                for a in path:
                    cap[a] -= push
                    cap[a^1] += push
                total += push
                cut = 0
                limit = len(path)
                while cap[path[cut]] > 0:
                    cut += 1
                u = frm[path[cut]]
                del path[cut:]
                continue
            arcs = adj[u]
            index = it[u]

            mark = level[u] + 1
            chosen = -1
            while index < limit:

                index += 1

                arc = path.pop()
                u = frm[arc]
                it[u] += 1
            else:

                u = to[chosen]
